description: This file defines an API route handler for a 'like' action in a Next.js application, specifically for handling POST requests related to an item identified by 'id'. It imports NextResponse from Next.js server utilities and exports an asynchronous POST function that simulates a successful 'like' operation, returning a JSON response with the 'ok' status and the item 'id'.
